title: The Practice Clap from the Doorway
youtube_title: The Practice Clap from the Doorway | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Bibi notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a someone clapping once from the doorway after you tried. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Bibi does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
